{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop refunded orders
df_clean = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Drop QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Check final number of rows
print(f'Final number of completed orders after removing QA: {len(df_final)}')

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = df_final.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()
print("Total revenue by channel after removing QA:")
print(total_revenue_by_channel)

# Find the channel with highest revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.loc[total_revenue_by_channel['revenue_clean'].idxmax(), 'channel']
print(f"Channel with highest revenue: {best_channel}")"}
